messages:
mike_support: P1 -> Riverview trial failing to finish onboarding. Provision calls intermittently return 403 when rotation runs. Renewal in ~5w, usage ramping. Ticket SUP-150777. Looping CS to own customer comms + AE handoff.

ops-bot: Alert: 4 provisioning failures for tenant riverview-prod in 6h. Pattern: 403 rotation_mismatch. https://redwood.inc/alerts/150777

ana_cs: Thanks Mike. I'll take comms. Can eng confirm whether this is tenant config or a recent platform change? Need impacted endpoints and a short mitigation ETA.

mike_support: Paste of sanitized response: `{"status":403,"error":"rotation_mismatch","request_id":"req_9f8e"}`. SE attempted manual rotate; customer still saw 403s.

henry_se: We observed similar failures for another trial yesterday after a key refresh path change. I can run an invalidate for riverview and prep a secure upload link for an ephemeral token. Ana — ask customer for a 25-min window tomorrow 08:30am PT and to pause their automated rotation job during the test.

keiko_eng: We're investigating a change in the key validation service that shipped last night. Rolling verifier-read replica back now to check. If rollback clears it, we'll cut a hotfix. ETA 30m.

lisa_ae: I'll join the call. Renewal risk: medium-high. Please give me a plain-language note we can send to the customer.

ana_cs: Draft customer note:
"Hi Riverview team — we're prioritizing an intermittent onboarding failure related to API key rotation. We're scheduling a short troubleshooting session tomorrow at 08:30am PT. As a temporary measure, please pause automated key rotation and, if possible, try a one-time manual rotate. We'll follow up with a remediation plan within 24 hours. For urgent issues contact ops@redwood.com"

mike_support: +1. Add SUP-150777 link and list impacted endpoints: POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/provision, POST /v1/tenants/:tenant/embeds. Marking P1.

henry_se: Secure upload link ready; I'll send to the customer after Ana confirms the window. I'll run the live repro during the session and report back.

keiko_eng: Rollback complete, monitoring for 10m. If errors drop to zero we'll push a hotfix and provide RCA.

ops-bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-20260324-21. Runbook: onboarding-provisioning. Escalation level: CS-P1.

ana_cs: Owners: Mike = support ticket owner, Henry = SE lead, Keiko = eng owner, Lisa = AE/renewal. I'll update SUP-150777 with the comms draft and calendar invite. Will post final customer note once rollback verified. :white_check_mark:
